payload.title: A controller counts as covered by an e2e spec when any string literal of the spec matches any one route pattern of the file, and the pattern ignores the HTTP method, so an untested write route is reported as covered by a spec that only reads the same path, which silences the write-boundary rule that now runs by default.
evidence: tools/aria-adapters/test-gap-adapter.ts:222-240 (the write-boundary finding is emitted only when no test matched and now runs by default)
tools/aria-adapters/test-gap-adapter.ts:539-565 (a pattern is built for every route decorator, Get included, with no method)
tools/aria-adapters/test-gap-adapter.ts:567-590 (one matching literal in a coverage spec covers the whole controller file)
tools/aria-adapters/test-gap-adapter.tool.json:56-60 (the contract says no test calls its route)
tools/aria-adapters/test-gap-adapter.test.ts:241-272 (the pinned twin differs by path and lives in its own file, never by method)
tools/aria-adapters/test-gap-adapter.test.ts:294-300 (the covering spec calls POST; no GET-only spec on a write route is pinned)
payload.rule_violated: The rule's contract (manifest premise: a write boundary with no test that exercises it) and the detector's job of not hiding an untested write.
payload.notes: A controller with @Get() listing and @Post('seal') whose only e2e spec does request.get('/api/harvests'): the Get pattern for the prefix matches the literal, callingProviders returns the spec, the file is covered, and the untested seal write yields no high_risk_source_without_adjacent_test finding. A root @Post() on a path a spec only GETs behaves the same (the review probe reproduced both with no findings). The twin test passes only because each controller is its own file. Close condition: Carry the HTTP method in the route pattern and match write routes only against spec calls whose callee names the same method (supertest .post, request.post, fetch with a method option), or record per-route coverage and report a controller as covered only when every write route is matched; add fixtures for a same-file Get plus uncalled Post and for a root Post with a GET-only spec. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 4). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
